title: BCPPO: Bachelier-Inspired Constrained Proximal Policy Optimization for Tail-Risk-Aware Safe Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Expected-cost constraints can still permit rare, high-cost events. Monte Carlo conditional value at risk (CVaR) gradients can be noisy at high confidence, whereas critics that model an outcome distribution add complexity. We propose BCPPO (Bachelier-Inspired Constrained Proximal Policy Optimization), a proximal policy optimization (PPO) method. Separately initialized cost-prediction networks (critics), trained with random sample masks, produce disagreement that marks predictions sensitive to which state-action regions occur in the training data and to critic training. A Bachelier formula for the expected amount above a reference level converts this disagreement into a smooth policy-update penalty. Gradients from this penalty do not alter the critics, so temporal-difference (TD) critic learning is unchanged. A saturation-aware controller adjusts the mean-cost penalty and stops accumulated error from growing while that penalty is clipped

translated_title: BCPPO：受巴舍利耶启发的面向尾部风险感知安全强化学习的约束近端策略优化
translated_abstract: 期望成本约束仍然可能允许罕见的高成本事件发生。蒙特卡洛条件风险价值（CVaR）梯度在高置信度下可能存在噪声，而建模结果分布的评价器则会增加复杂性。我们提出了BCPPO（受巴舍利耶启发的约束近端策略优化），这是一种近端策略优化（PPO）方法。分别初始化的成本预测网络（评价器）通过随机样本掩码进行训练，其产生的不一致性标志着预测对训练数据中出现的状态-动作区域以及评价器训练本身的敏感性。一个用于计算超过参考水平的期望量的巴舍利耶公式将这种不一致性转化为平滑的策略更新惩罚。来自该惩罚的梯度不会改变评价器，因此时序差分（TD）评价器学习保持不变。一个感知饱和的控制器会调整平均成本惩罚，并在该惩罚被截断时阻止累积误差的增长。
tldr: 提出BCPPO方法，通过独立初始化成本评价器之间的不一致性并借助巴舍利耶公式将其转化为平滑的策略更新惩罚，在不干扰时序差分评价器学习的前提下实现尾部风险感知的安全强化学习。
en_tdlr: BCPPO converts disagreement between separately initialized cost critics into a smooth policy-update penalty via a Bachelier formula, enabling tail-risk-aware safe reinforcement learning while keeping TD critic learning unchanged.
